title: Free UNI claim A League title
description: Free UNI - Griffin 77-57 Free UNI outgunned Griffin in the fourth game of the championship series to conquer A League trophy. The game was mostly controlled by Free UNI. Griffin managed to win third quarter 20-18. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Worth to mention a great performance of American guard Kevon Voyles (190-2000, college: Marshall) who helped to win the game recording 25 points, 5 assists and 4 steals. Guard Levan Qvartskhava (194-2002) contributed with 14 points and 5 rebounds for the winners. American forward Daniel Ransom (198, college: OKBU, agency: Interperformances) replied with a double-double by scoring 21 points and 10 rebounds (made all of his eight free throws) and forward Vakhtang Gogberashvili (202-2002) added 12 points, 6 rebounds and 4 assists in the effort for Griffin.
